scripts.title: KULTHX EDITOR GUI
scripts.features:
## **Welcome to KULTHX Editor**


KULTHX Editor is a powerful, modern in-game GUI editor designed for creators who want full control over interface design—perfect for environments like Synapse X, Delta, Arceus X, KRNL, and more.

---

### **Key Features for Users:**

**• Fully Interactive UI Builder**  
Create buttons, frames, labels, and more with a single click—everything you need to build clean, custom user interfaces.

**• Real-Time Customization**  
Modify position, size, colors, fonts, corners, and strokes instantly. The properties panel adjusts to whatever you select.

**• Button-to-Frame Binding System**  
Easily connect any button to toggle frames or elements—no scripting required.

**• Smooth Slide-In Panels**  
Hide and show the Toolbox and Properties panels using smart sliding arrows, keeping your workspace clean and focused.

**• Drag and Drop Editing**  
Move any UI element freely with your mouse, directly inside the editor. Visual editing made simple.

**• Auto-Remove In-Game Tools**  
KULTHX removes all tools from your character and backpack automatically, ensuring nothing interrupts your editing flow.

**• Immersive Editing Environment**  
The camera moves above the sky, a chill soundtrack starts playing, and the game switches to night mode—all locally—setting the mood for focused design.

**• Beautiful Welcome Screen & Logo**  
Start your session with a sleek welcome screen and custom-designed KULTHX logo that elevates your experience.

---

> Whether you're a beginner or advanced UI builder, KULTHX Editor gives you the freedom to build, design, and express with ease.

ButtonsFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.1, 0)
ButtonsFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)

local function makeButton(parent, pos, text, color)
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", parent)
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.25, 0, 1, 0)
	btn.Position = UDim2.new(pos, 0, 0, 0)
	btn.Text = text
	btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = color
	btn.TextScaled = true
	return btn
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function click()
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local character = player.Character
		if character then -- removing head
			local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
			local humanoidRootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local guiParent = humanoidRootPart or character

			-- removing hair etc shit for bald player
			for _, child in character:GetChildren() do
				if child:IsA("Accessory") and child.AccessoryType == Enum.AccessoryType.Hair then
					child:Destroy()
				end
			end

			if head then
				-- creating bbg
				local gui1 = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
				gui1.Adornee = head
				gui1.Size = UDim2.new(2.5, 0, 2.5, 0)
				gui1.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 0.2, 0)
				gui1.AlwaysOnTop = true
				gui1.Parent = guiParent

				-- Create ImageLabel
				local text1 = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
				text1.Image = "rbxassetid://ChangeMe" -- face`s id
				text1.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
				text1.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
				text1.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				text1.Parent = gui1

				-- ending
			end
		end
	end
end
